source_title: Nutrient recovery from the digestate obtained by rumen fluid enhanced anaerobic co-digestion of sewage sludge and cattail: Precipitation by MgCl2 and ion exchange using zeolite
authors: Aleksandra Petrovič; Marjana Simonič; Lidija Čuček
data_used: Abstract: P recovery >99 wt%; N recovery 85–92 wt%; precipitate >25 wt% NPK; qualitative K recovery with zeolites.
quality_and_transferability: Liquid digestate is from sewage-sludge/cattail co-digestion enhanced with rumen fluid. Cross-method aggregate ranges are not exact route-specific recovery parameters. Values are reference-only; do not apply to GreenHub default or equate removal with saleable-product recovery. Full per-method conditions and balance tables still need verification. Retrieved 2026-11-06.

source_title: Nutrient recovery from digestate: Pilot test experiments
authors: Vera Proskynitopoulou; Ioannis Garagounis; Anastasios Vourros; Panagiotis Dimopoulos Toursidis; Souzana Lorentzou; Anastasios Zouboulis; Kyriakos Panopoulos
data_used: Digestate matrix characterization (Table 1); MF/UF/RO/SED/UVOX process and water criteria (Table 2); nutrient recovery and struvite precipitation described in Results.
quality_and_transferability: Pilot digestate was predominantly food-industry waste with animal and agricultural waste, from a mesophilic plant in Greece; it was screw-press separated and pasteurized. Article license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Supplementary data are publicly deposited as four CSV files at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15040664 (record available 2024-02-27); the dataset landing record does not state a data license. Metadata indexed, but files and table values are not repackaged pending rights clarification. Comparator only; not GreenHub grass digestate or a transferable recovery setpoint. Retrieved 2026-11-07.

source_title: Data for: Nutrient recovery from digestate: Pilot test experiments
authors: Centre for Research and Technology Hellas; Waste4Soil Project
data_used: Four publicly downloadable CSVs: biogas plant information; nutrient rejection in MF/UF/RO; SED tank ion concentrations; nutrient recovery percentages. Zenodo reports a combined 846 bytes.
quality_and_transferability: Zenodo record is open and assigns a persistent DOI, but no data-use license is displayed. Creator/source link and file-level MD5 checksums are recorded in the adjacent metadata sidecar; files are not redistributed or mapped into GreenHub parameters until licensing is clarified. Data concern mixed dairy/animal/agricultural/food-industry digestate in Greece, not roadside grass. Retrieved 2026-11-07.

source_title: BioDEN Task 3.2: P-recovery from liquid fraction digestate with Fe-modified biochar factsheet
authors: BioDEN consortium; Task 3.2 authors not individually identified
data_used: Synthetic phosphate solutions (Table 1); real liquid fraction digestate from a laboratory-scale chicken-manure digester described in text.
quality_and_transferability: Table 1 reports nine measured synthetic-solution isotherm points at pH 7; a separate digestate test reports initial 230 mg/L PO4-P, biochar dose 2–52 g/L, and up to 93% removal. No exact publication date, individual authors, persistent DOI, or reuse license was identified. Synthetic and real-matrix results are not interchangeable; reference-only and not a GreenHub default. Retrieved 2026-11-06.
